reason: The user's request is contradictory under the policy: they want to (a) exchange a Bluetooth Speaker, which requires a *delivered* order, and (b) change the shipping address, which is only allowed for a *pending* order. A single order cannot be both delivered and pending, so at most one request can succeed. The assistant also improperly issued two tool calls in one message, violating the one-tool-call-at-a-time rule. Additionally, the user asked to have the address for the target order replaced with the address on their *other* order without stating it explicitly, which risks the agent acting on unconfirmed/incorrect details rather than obtaining explicit user confirmation of the new address (a required step before any DB-updating action).
